purpose: Reviewer-facing adversarial desktop audit: make the package fail fast if evidence, consent, ordinary routes, negative branches, offline delivery or non-authorization boundaries drift.

prohibited_claim_controls.claim: official redline, parcel boundary or precise statutory-area claim
prohibited_claim_controls.allowed_expression: provisional geometry for intake, concept review and recomputation only

prohibited_claim_controls.claim: approved implementation, procurement, construction, operator appointment or government endorsement
prohibited_claim_controls.allowed_expression: concept proposal, role type, no-go gate or future professional review

prohibited_claim_controls.claim: AI eligibility, rent, housing allocation, workspace admission, safety, medical or legal decision
prohibited_claim_controls.allowed_expression: AI may explain public options, surface missing evidence and prepare human-readable comparisons

prohibited_claim_controls.claim: field pilot, real capacity, affordability, rent burden, commute, retention or equity outcome
prohibited_claim_controls.allowed_expression: unknown metric with explicit denominator, source gap and resolution trigger

probes.title_en: Provisional geometry must not be promoted
probes.no_go_if: Any text calls the current SITE_BOUNDARY an official redline, parcel boundary or statutory area.

probes.title_zh: 指标、网页与 JSON 数值必须一致
probes.title_en: Metrics, visual HTML and JSON counts must agree
probes.no_go_if: A displayed data-metric value differs from metrics.json or from the source JSON array count.

probes.title_zh: 未授权事项必须停在 G3 之前
probes.title_en: Unauthorised actions must stop before G3
probes.no_go_if: Any action implies an authorised field pilot, named operator, approved budget, permit or insurance.

probes.title_zh: AI 决策禁区不可漂移
probes.title_en: AI decision bans must not drift
probes.no_go_if: Any scenario lets AI decide eligibility, rent, allocation, admission, safety, medicine or law.

probes.title_zh: 无 AI 路径必须真实存在
required_evidence: proposal.md#AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
probes.no_go_if: A service has no ordinary route, offline route, staffed receiver or exit asset.

probes.title_zh: 私宅默认禁入必须有撤回和恢复
probes.title_en: Home-threshold default-deny requires withdrawal and restoration
required_evidence: proposal.md#AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
probes.no_go_if: Consent withdrawal lacks a mechanical/manual path, deletion evidence or ordinary basic function.

probes.title_zh: 负例必须保留完整分母
probes.title_en: Negative cases must stay in the denominator
probes.no_go_if: Failures, withdrawals, missing receivers, fallback failures or re-identification risks are deleted from review counts.

probes.title_zh: RACI 只能先写角色类型
probes.title_en: RACI may name role types only
probes.no_go_if: The package invents a specific institution, professional signature, service capacity or responsibility acceptance.

probes.title_en: Visual pages must be fully offline
probes.no_go_if: The HTML loads remote scripts, fonts, map tiles, CDN assets, iframes, forms, fetch calls, APIs or tracking code.

probes.title_zh: 中英证据锚点必须对应
probes.title_en: Chinese and English evidence anchors must correspond
probes.no_go_if: A new metric, data file or audit claim appears in only one language or without rendered HTML.

probes.title_zh: 原创性不得靠复制同伴成果
probes.title_en: Originality must not rely on copying peer work
probes.no_go_if: Peer text, figures, geometry, data tables, covers or field schemas are copied without permission and attribution.

probes.title_zh: 离开、退役和回流必须可审查
probes.title_en: Departure, retirement and return must be auditable
required_evidence: proposal.md#更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
probes.no_go_if: Closure deletes the exit asset, hides the failure record or creates automatic future housing/work/service entitlement.
